simple.meaning: מִשְׁטוֹחַ (mishṭôwach) is a Hebrew word meaning “a spreading -place.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִשְׁטוֹחַ (H4894) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 26:5, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁטוֹחַ (H4894) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִשְׁטוֹחַ (H4894) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִשְׁטוֹחַ (mishṭôwach) / H4894 is traced through Ezekiel 26:5, Ezekiel 26:14, Ezekiel 47:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.

timeline.evidenceText: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh. ‘She will become plunder for the nations.
I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place for the spreading of nets. You will be built no more; for I Yahweh have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

It will happen, that fishermen will stand by it. From En Gedi even to En Eglaim will be a place for the spreading of nets. Their fish will be after their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceedingly many.

definitions.full: H4894. mishtowach [ מִשְׁטָח ] noun [masculine] spreading-place (Late Hebrew for drying figs, etc., (ARSK Ency. Bib. FRUIT, 1568 )); — construct חֲרָמִים מִשְׁטַח Ezek 26:5 , 14 . [ מִשְׁטוֺחַ ] noun [masculine] id.; — ׳מ לַחֲרָמִים Ezek 47:10 . שֹׁטֵט see שִׁטִּים שׁוט, see above.
